findings.evidence: `rg -n "theorem .*energy"` finds only `energy_def`, `energy_const`, `energy_self`, `energy_symm`, `energy_nonneg`, `IsGeodesicCurveOn.energy_eq`, and the variation theorems; Mathlib provides `intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals` at `Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Integral/IntervalIntegral/Basic.lean:1097`.
findings.fix: Add an `energy_add_adjacent` theorem, with the necessary `IntervalIntegrable` hypotheses, deriving `energy I γ a c = energy I γ a b + energy I γ b c` from `intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals`.
findings.issue: The public API has no theorem expressing energy additivity across adjacent parameter intervals, so consumers must unfold `energy` to split a curve segment.

summary: The energy definition lacks the basic interval-composition theorem needed to use it abstractly on subdivided curves.
